lineage: game-compiler - Sony/Cygnus 2.9-ee-991111b (patched game default; SN parity target)
provenance: SN-distributed GNUPro/SCE source; Wayback ps2dev.sourceforge.net ee/gnu-ee-binutils-gcc-1.1.tar.gz (sha256 1f518043e252d6eda726386971d52eda26541ab936ea73a9783d73712b595f92)
role: Opt-in (-mastra-keep-frame-order) retention of the save_restore_insns emission order for prologue saves / epilogue restores under the scheduler.
mechanism: haifa-sched.c rank_for_schedule normally compares INSN_PRIORITY first, which reorders independent prologue saves (it sinks the $ra save past the callee-saved ones). With the flag, frame-related insns are ranked by INSN_LUID (program order). The behavior is opt-in because the retail objects mix both orders across units; fun_0023c610 needs the emission order, most other units need the default scheduler result.
